title: Insights page has no news and no dates
what_happened: I pressed Explore insights and landed on a page called Learn. The cards are explainers like NFL vs NCAAF and Reading the line. None shows a date, and none is about a game coming up this week.
expected: Recent pieces about upcoming games, each with a publish date, under a heading that matches the button I pressed

title: No way to follow or come back without an account
what_happened: I looked on the home page, the Learn page, an article and the footer for a way to get new pieces sent to me or to follow the site. The footer has Terms, Privacy, Leaderboard, Cookies and Contact; there is no newsletter, no email sign-up for articles, and no follow option. The only thing on offer is Sign in.
expected: A simple way to come back for new analysis, such as an email digest, without making a full account

repro.step: tap "Learn 6 min NCAA FOOTBALL NFL vs NCAAF: what changes when you pick college games Same pick — winner, spread, total — but"
